TOOLING BURST T3f — SPEC § 7 row "T3f — Godot stub + viewer wheel" (Run C-3, the matrix run: motion tooling for cutting Grok image-to-video clips into registered game loops). task_id "T3f".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, and § 7 (the intro paragraph and the row "T3f — Godot stub + viewer wheel" — that row is your contract; its Acceptance column is how your work is measured).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. review/encode.py and review/cell_packet.py (T3d), runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-xv-cut-04/ (frames + rest frame for the 2-cell fixture), /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/run_03/preview/index.html (an old self-contained viewer — layout ideas only). Godot binary: /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot (4.6; run it headless as the row says; if it writes user data under ~/Library, that is expected and permitted).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy (+ sklearn) ONLY; ffmpeg/ffprobe at /opt/homebrew/bin/.

BUILD exactly the SPEC row — every function named, with the named parameters and defaults, and its tests (unittest, stdlib) including the known-bad cases. Create export/__init__.py + export/godot_import.py + review/viewer_wheel.py + tests; build the 2-cell fixture project under runs/C-3/t3/T3f/fixture_project/ and the viewer under runs/C-3/t3/T3f/viewer/; run the two headless Godot commands and paste their exit codes and any ERROR lines into the receipt concerns.
Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the named standing reds (the four T0-d3 motif reds: test_f04_outside_at_least_three + three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid; and test_k3_combat_report_only until T3c fixes it); report exact counts (tests_run, successful) and name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-3/t3/T3f/, and any existing test file except where the SPEC row names a fix. Existing modules may be EXTENDED only as the row says (new parameters with backward-compatible defaults; the regression lock must stay green). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/ or runs/C-3/t3/T3f/tmp/ (delete large temporaries — decoded video frames — before you return).
PRIORITY if time runs short: the instruments and their synthetic tests first, the real-clip acceptance second, polish never; deliver what is done with honest concerns rather than exceeding the cap.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T3f"): files = every file you created or modified (repo-absolute or burst-relative paths) with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with numbers (every acceptance quantity: measured value vs the SPEC row's criterion; wall times; suite counts). Never PASS/FAIL.
